name: Pet battles: .petbattle sim runs a whole battle for a GM and refuses players and bad input
contract: Phase 2 of the pet battle port. On a worldserver that applied the pet battle pending SQL, a GM's
.petbattle sim <speciesA> <speciesB> [level] [seed] prints a header naming both pets, the level and the
seed, round lines, and a result line. A player without GM security is refused, as are an unknown species
and a level outside 1-25. The same command also runs from the server console.

steps.label: the header names both pets, the level and the seed
